text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you for your support!
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
From your perspective, Trainer, how was it?
My debut race, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, hearing you say that brings me the utmost joy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The first step toward our goal.
I suppose we have managed to take that, at least.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Trainer-san.
I was just lost in a bit of sentimentality.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Having finally made her debut,
she had earned the right to challenge her goals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho is a race full of memories for Grandmother and Grandfather,
the pillars of the Mejiro family...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Which is why I am determined to win
the 'Tenno Sho', no matter what."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Especially since I have always been recognized for my talent as a stayer—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I would like to set our sights on conquering the Spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: As someone born into the Mejiro family and supported by all of its members...
choice_data_list: Let's do our best aiming for the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Even so, we've only just stood at the starting line, and the Tenno Sho is still far off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Since we have plenty of time,
we must properly hone our skills.
choice_data_list: First, let's gain experience in Junior and Classic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, so that one day
I will without fail win the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
